nodes.label: Equity Curve — EUR/USD Backtest
nodes.description: Two-panel backtest result chart for EUR/USD. Top panel: equity curve in units of risk (R) from mid-2024 to mid-2026, showing cumulative profit peaking near 22R before declining to ~9R. Bottom panel: per-trade P&L bar chart with green (winning) and red (losing) trades, max win ~2R, max loss ~-1R.

nodes.label: Per-Trade P&L Distribution — EUR/USD Backtest
nodes.description: Bar chart subplot showing individual trade results in R-multiples, with winning trades (teal/green bars reaching up to 2R) and losing trades (red bars reaching down to -1R) across the backtest period 2024-2026.
